'''Honey glazed k'lor'slug''' was a meal made from the meat of [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]]. It was one of the dishes served at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR Onslaught" />
